payload.text: hv, 23 Nov 2026, in devbin-vc's window (relayed by devbin-vc; the quote is hv's, the question devbin-vc's): 'Yes, wait so that is fixed, please.' Molt 1.4.8 waits for devbin 0.1.29's sweep into Molt, so its formula carries I514ea74's fix (brew re-signs the keg after the manifest's hashes, so the formula re-hashes after install), and 0.1.29's pre-tag formula render check runs on the cut. molt-dc builds the devbin#0326 adoption meanwhile; devbin-vc says when 0.1.29 is out and swept, and 1.4.8 then books its cut at the Desk.
